nodes.label: VOP Interwoven Trace Map (Approximate Call Tree)
nodes.norm_label: vop interwoven trace map (approximate call tree)

nodes.label: 3D Model Geometry as Sole Occlusion Authority
nodes.rationale: 3D model geometry is the ONLY occlusion truth; 2D annotation NEVER occludes model geometry. This is a non-negotiable architectural principle to prevent annotations from incorrectly hiding model elements, preserving correctness of occupancy maps.
nodes.norm_label: 3d model geometry as sole occlusion authority

nodes.label: UV Classification System (TINY / LINEAR / AREAL)
nodes.rationale: Elements are classified by projected footprint size in grid cells. TINY (both dims <=2), LINEAR (one dim <=2, other >2), AREAL (both dims >2). This controls cost/rendering strategy: AREAL gets full tessellation and depth buffer writes (occlusion authority); TINY/LINEAR use lightweight proxies and never write depth (avoids false occlusion).

nodes.label: Confidence-Based Occlusion Semantics
nodes.rationale: AREAL elements carry a confidence level from geometry extraction. Only HIGH-confidence AREAL geometry writes authoritative occlusion (w_occ / model_mask). MEDIUM and LOW confidence use proxy ink but do not gate occlusion. Rationale: a wrong occlusion permanently skips later elements; approximate geometry must err toward doing more work (staying visible).

nodes.label: Interwoven Render Pipeline Architecture
nodes.rationale: Classification, geometry extraction, depth ordering, occlusion, and raster writes are blended in one model pass for throughput rather than staged as strict contracts. This maximizes performance but makes introducing strict stage boundary artifacts (PrimitiveWorld, PrimitiveView) a near-scratch effort.

nodes.label: No Silent Failure Rule
nodes.rationale: Bare except is forbidden. All recoverable errors must be recorded in Diagnostics and categorized. If recovery is not clearly safe, fail loudly. This prevents silent data corruption in occupancy outputs.

nodes.label: Single Source of Truth Rule
nodes.rationale: Category inclusion/exclusion defined in one place, view bounds resolution centralized, source identity normalized (HOST|LINK|DWG) before rasterization. Prevents divergent policy logic causing inconsistent outputs.

nodes.label: Proxy Ink Semantics (model_proxy_key)
nodes.rationale: TINY and LINEAR elements emit proxy representations (UV_AABB/OBB) to model_proxy_key layer. Proxy ink is acceptable as model presence signal but NOT as occlusion truth. This allows lightweight but counted model presence without false occlusion writes.

nodes.label: 8-State Occupancy Cell Partition Invariant
nodes.rationale: Cells_Empty + Cells_ModelOnly + Cells_AnnoOnly + Cells_ExtOnly + Cells_ModelAnno + Cells_ModelExt + Cells_AnnoExt + Cells_All3 must always equal TotalCells. This invariant is the canonical correctness check for CSV output.

nodes.label: RootStyleCache (View-level Metrics Cache)
nodes.rationale: Single JSON file (vop_view_cache.json) keyed by view id + signature, storing metadata/metrics/row payload — not full rasters. Designed for streaming reuse without memory cost of raster arrays.

nodes.label: View Signature (Cache Match Token)
nodes.rationale: View-signature encodes view/config/doc state inputs and is used as cache match token. Root cache invalidates on exporter version, config hash, and project guid mismatch.

nodes.label: TileMap Spatial Acceleration and Early-Out Occlusion
nodes.rationale: Tile-based early-out: skip element if all overlapped tiles are fully filled AND nearer than element z. Saves 60-80% geometry work for occluded elements. Safe only against depth-aware occlusion buffers.
nodes.norm_label: tilemap spatial acceleration and early-out occlusion

nodes.label: Annotation Non-Occlusion Layering Principle
nodes.rationale: 2D annotation is rasterized in a separate pass after model processing and never occludes model geometry. anno_over_model is a derived field (annotation AND model presence), not an occlusion relationship.

nodes.label: Golden Baseline Regression Testing
nodes.rationale: Hash-based comparison (manifest.sha256) against known-good CSV/PNG outputs. Volatile columns (RunId, ElapsedSec, ConfigHash) are excluded from comparison to prevent false positives from non-semantic changes.

nodes.label: Diagnostics Always-On Contract
nodes.rationale: Diagnostics object is always enabled and is not logging. Errors must include phase, view id, element id, source type, exception type, and message. Exporters must declare which raster layers they rely on.

nodes.label: Proxy Edge Mask Mode Stub (_stamp_proxy_edges)
nodes.rationale: proxy_mask_mode='edges' routes to _stamp_proxy_edges which is a stub (pass). This is a P0 defect: a selectable mode that does not perform advertised behavior.

nodes.label: Visibility Gating Stub (is_element_visible_in_view)
nodes.rationale: is_element_visible_in_view always returns True; visibility relies entirely on collector behavior. A P1 gap versus a proper post-collection category/template/manual-hide gate.

nodes.label: over_model_includes_proxies Config Flag
nodes.rationale: Controls whether TINY/LINEAR proxy presence counts as 'model presence' when computing anno_over_model. When True, annotation overlapping proxy ink counts as over-model. When False, only AREAL occluders count.

nodes.label: Two-Tier Primitive Cache Contract (Proposed, Not Implemented)
nodes.rationale: Proposed architecture separates Tier-1 (world primitives keyed by extraction inputs) and Tier-2 (projected primitives keyed by geometry fingerprint + view basis/raster settings) caches. Not implemented in current codebase; current code has generic LRU and element fingerprint caches without formal two-tier split.
nodes.norm_label: two-tier primitive cache contract (proposed, not implemented)

nodes.label: SSM-Compatible CSV Export Format
nodes.rationale: Two CSV files: views_core_YYYY-MM-DD.csv and views_vop_YYYY-MM-DD.csv. Must match existing SSM exporter output format for integration with analytics workflows.

nodes.label: Front-to-Back Depth Ordering for Model Processing
nodes.norm_label: front-to-back depth ordering for model processing

nodes.label: Multi-Strategy Silhouette Extraction with Fallbacks
nodes.rationale: get_element_silhouette uses multiple extraction strategies (planar_face_loops, silhouette_edges, geometry_polygon, OBB/AABB fallback). Strategy used determines geometry confidence level, which in turn controls whether AREAL elements write occlusion.

nodes.label: AREAL Fallback Occlusion Semantics Contradiction (P0 Debt)
nodes.rationale: Top-level comment states AREAL fallback to OBB/AABB still writes occlusion, while nearby principles say only high-confidence AREAL contributes to occlusion. This architecture-contract contradiction needs explicit resolution.
nodes.norm_label: areal fallback occlusion semantics contradiction (p0 debt)

nodes.label: Streaming Pipeline (Memory-Aware Per-View Export)
nodes.rationale: run_vop_pipeline_streaming is the memory-aware path that streams per-view export callbacks and persists root cache, designed for large models where holding all rasters in memory would be prohibitive.

nodes.label: LRU Element Cache with Fingerprint Keying
nodes.rationale: ElementCache uses LRU with (elem_id, source_id) key and optional persistence. Fingerprint-based keying allows cross-view geometry reuse without re-extraction.
nodes.norm_label: lru element cache with fingerprint keying

nodes.label: Worst-Case First Coding Principle
nodes.rationale: Code must behave correctly under null/missing geometry, unloaded/partially broken links, rotated transforms, extreme view scales, and large models. Prevents edge-case crashes in production Revit environments.

nodes.label: Diagnostics Wiring Debt (TODO Placeholders in Exception Handlers)
nodes.rationale: Multiple exception handlers carry 'TODO: Add diagnostics when diag becomes available' placeholders in entry_dynamo.py, csv_export.py, root_cache.py, streaming.py. P1 priority to close this gap against diagnostics contract.
nodes.norm_label: diagnostics wiring debt (todo placeholders in exception handlers)

nodes.label: Multihot Model Class Cells (ModelClassCells_*)
nodes.rationale: ModelClassCells_WALL, _DOOR, etc. are multihot: a single cell can increment multiple columns. sum(ModelClassCells_*) is NOT required to equal any single partition bucket and may exceed model-present cell counts.

nodes.label: Dormant Per-View Disk Cache (view_cache_enabled=False)
nodes.rationale: process_document_views defines per-view cache plumbing but force-disables it via view_cache_enabled=False. P1 debt: remove or finalize to reduce maintenance burden and reader confusion.
